zh:
蒙纳士大学（Monash University）成立于1958年，位于澳大利亚维多利亚州墨尔本市，是澳大利亚八校联盟核心成员，也是澳大利亚规模最大的公立研究型大学。学校下设10个学院，覆盖医学、法律、商学、工程、艺术、教育等领域，在校生超82000人，其中研究生约27000名。
蒙纳士大学在2026QS世界大学排名中位列全球第36位，其工商管理学科位列全球第3、澳大利亚第1位，药学与药理学位列全球第4、澳大利亚第1位。学校以“改变”为核心办学理念，注重科研成果的实际转化，在生物医药、可持续发展、人工智能等领域取得了大量突破性成果，拥有400余种奖学金，覆盖各阶段学生。2026QS世界大学排名中，蒙纳士大学位列世界第36位。
en: Monash University is a public research university in Australia. Founded in 1958, it is located in Melbourne, Victoria, a core member of the Group of Eight, and Australia's largest university. The University comprises 10 faculties, covering medicine, law, business, engineering, arts, and education, with over 82,000 enrolled students, including 27,000 graduate students. Ranked 36th globally in the 2026 QS World University Rankings, it is 3rd in the world for Business Administration and 4th globally for Pharmacy and Pharmacology, both 1st in Australia. Guided by the mission to 'make change', Monash focuses on the translation of research into real-world impact. Ranked No.36 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
